name: spindle-sealed-node
docker_compose_file:
services:
  node:
    image: REPLACE_REGISTRY/spindle-node-sealed@sha256:REPLACE_WITH_IMAGE_DIGEST
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - SPINDLE_API_URL=${SPINDLE_API_URL}
      - SPINDLE_TOKEN=${SPINDLE_TOKEN}
      - SPINDLE_VLLM_MODEL=${SPINDLE_VLLM_MODEL}
      - SPINDLE_SEALED=1
      - DSTACK_SOCKET=/var/run/dstack.sock
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - spindle-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
              capabilities: [gpu]
volumes:
  spindle-data:
